description: Use this when the person asks who has a login in their account or how many products and logins it holds. Returns the logins of the connected account and how many products and logins it holds and uses, and whether the manufacturer page is checked and public. Do not use for anything about other companies.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.
